A.estimand: fraction of 8 systematically spaced official indexed XV profiles whose rendered page contains exactly one open-data roster fullname; only string correspondence, NOT stable ID validation
A.outcome: page HTML renders roster key name unambiguously

B.H1: Most profiles display exactly one roster name matching corresponding office snapshot
B.H0: No recognizable fullname or multiple ambiguous names
B.H_other: HTML reflects a different name order or stale roster

C.budget: 8 profile HTTPS downloads <=2MB each, same verified host
C.control: same official roster source, indexed profile ID before name matching; none stored in public output
C.falsifier: zero or ambiguous direct matches, or profile absent

D.instrument: scripts/ab20_profile_roster_probe.py, index URLs discovered, original roster re-downloaded in CI
D.precautions: No person names or aliases in logs/output; no legal name-to-ID mapping is committed

F.adversarial: Rendered page may list other names in sidebar; exact normalized name matches are only a diagnostic

G.holdout: unseen indexed profiles not yet sampled, eligible for later independent check

J.next: choose based on actual ambiguity rate, not preset
